source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 9 (a)-(b): population P(t) = 70000 + 10000 cos(pi t/6 - pi/2). Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 9 Suppose the population of a coastal city follows a sinusoidal pattern due to seasonal migration. The population of the city over the course of a year can be modeled by the equation: \(P(t) = 70000 + 10000\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), \(P(t)\) is the population at time \(t\) (\(t\) is the time in months, with \(t = 0\) corresponding to January 1st). where \(t\) denoted the months in a year. (a) Find the population of a city at \(t = 7\) months
blocks.explanation:
Value rakhne ka sawal: \(t = 7\).
Plan: angle \(\frac{7\pi}{6} - \frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\), jis ka cosine \(-\frac{1}{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(t) = 70000 + 10000\cos(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{2})\), \(t = 7\).
Humein find karna hai: 7 mahine baad (yani 1 August ko) aabadi \(P(7)\).
Tareeqa: Value rakhenge; \(\cos 120^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\).

Angle nikalein
\[\tfrac{7\pi}{6} - \tfrac{\pi}{2} = \tfrac{7\pi}{6} - \tfrac{3\pi}{6}\]
\[= \tfrac{4\pi}{6} = \tfrac{2\pi}{3} = 120^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Fractions minus karne ke liye denominator ek kiya: \(\frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{3\pi}{6}\). Phir \(\frac{4\pi}{6} = \frac{2\pi}{3}\), jo \(120^{\circ}\) hai.

\(P\) nikalein
\[P(7) = 70000 + 10000\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
\[= 70000 - 5000 = 65000\]
Kyun: \(120^{\circ}\) Quadrant II mein hai jahan cosine negative hai: \(\cos 120^{\circ} = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -\frac{1}{2}\).

Tasdeeq
\[60000 \le 65000 \le 80000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Aabadi average 70000 se 10000 upar neeche hi jati hai; 65000 is range mein hai.

blocks.prompt: 9 Suppose the population of a coastal city follows a sinusoidal pattern due to seasonal migration. The population of the city over the course of a year can be modeled by the equation: \(P(t) = 70000 + 10000\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), \(P(t)\) is the population at time \(t\) (\(t\) is the time in months, with \(t = 0\) corresponding to January 1st). where \(t\) denoted the months in a year. (b) Find the maximum population
blocks.explanation:
\(a + b\cos(\ldots)\) ki sab se bari value.
Plan: cosine zyada se zyada 1.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(t) = 70000 + 10000\cos(\frac{\pi}{6}t - \frac{\pi}{2})\).
Humein find karna hai: sab se zyada aabadi.
Tareeqa: \(\cos \le 1\), is liye \(P \le 70000 + 10000\).

Cosine ki range lagayein
\[-1 \le \cos(\ldots) \le 1\]
\[60000 \le P(t) \le 80000\]
Kyun: 10000 se multiply (positive) aur 70000 jama kiya. Aabadi 60000 aur 80000 ke darmiyan rehti hai.

Yeh kab hota hai
\[\tfrac{\pi}{6}t - \tfrac{\pi}{2} = 0 \Rightarrow t = 3\]
Kyun: Cosine angle 0 par 1 hota hai. \(t = 3\) mahine, yani 1 April: migration ka mausam jab log sab se zyada aate hain.

Tasdeeq
\[P(3) = 70000 + 10000\cos 0 = 80000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(t = 3\) rakhne se waqai 80000 aata hai.
